name: stella
description: Connect stella to search case law and legislation and work with accessible matters and documents.

interface.longDescription: Connect stella to search case law and legislation and work with the matters your account can access. Read documents, find templates, inspect contacts, and perform supported document and matter updates through separate tools. Sign in to stella in your browser and review the requested permissions before connecting. Available tools depend on your permissions and the features enabled for your organization. Results include source references where available. You need a stella account and access to an organization. Legal-source coverage varies by jurisdiction.
capabilities: Manage tasks, contacts, and matter records
defaultPrompt: Find Czech Supreme Court decisions on dismissal for redundancy and summarize the key reasoning.
What does the Czech Labour Code say about the notice period? Quote the provision.
List my matters and the tasks that are due this week.

review.commerce_description: stella does not sell products or process payments in conversations.
